title: Deposit security deposits with the Authority
what: Deposit each security deposit received with the Authority within 10 working days.

sources.title: Residential Tenancy Act 1997 (Tas)
sources.quote: A property agent who receives a security deposit from a tenant under subsection (2)(b) must deposit that money with the Authority within 10 working days after receiving it

reach.condition: if it manages residential tenancies and receives security deposits
